title: Drop and Deadline
author: Beatrix Dravenmoor
blurb: August Lockridge, a private security contractor guarding clients nobody trusts, has spent seven years following rules that keep getting rewritten. Then a burner phone that shouldn't exist starts ringing with a familiar voice on the line — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must trade the one secret worth killing for before the summit convenes.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
